lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag malaar baanee bhagat naamadev jeeu kee ||
lines.translation: Raag Malaar, The Word Of The Devotee Naam Dayv Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵੀਲੇ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: seveele gopaal raai akul nira(n)jan ||
lines.translation: Serve the King, the Sovereign Lord of the World. He has no ancestry; He is immaculate and pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat daan deejai jaachahi sa(n)t jan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Please bless me with the gift of devotion, which the humble Saints beg for. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਦਿਗ ਦਿਸੈ ਸਰਾਇਚਾ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਭਵਨ ਚਿਤ੍ਰਸਾਲਾ ਸਪਤ ਲੋਕ ਸਾਮਾਨਿ ਪੂਰੀਅਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa(n) chai ghar dig disai saraaichaa baiku(n)th bhavan chitrasaalaa sapat lok saamaan pooreeale ||
lines.translation: His Home is the pavilion seen in all directions; His ornamental heavenly realms fill the seven worlds alike.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਲਛਿਮੀ ਕੁਆਰੀ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੀਵੜੇ ਕਉਤਕੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਕੋਟਵਾਲੁ ਸੁ ਕਰਾ ਸਿਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa(n) chai ghar lachhimee kuaaree cha(n)d sooraj deevaRe kautak kaal bapuRaa kotavaal s karaa siree ||
lines.translation: In His Home, the virgin Lakshmi dwells. The moon and the sun are His two lamps; the wretched Messenger of Death stages his dramas, and levies taxes on all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁ ਐਸਾ ਰਾਜਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਨਰਹਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: s aisaa raajaa sree naraharee ||1||
lines.translation: Such is my Sovereign Lord King, the Supreme Lord of all. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਕੁਲਾਲੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਚਤੁਰ ਮੁਖੁ ਡਾਂਵੜਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਰਾਚੀਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa(n) chai ghar kulaal brahamaa chatur mukh daa(n)vaRaa jin bisv sa(n)saar raacheele ||
lines.translation: In His House, the four-faced Brahma, the cosmic potter lives. He created the entire universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਈਸਰੁ ਬਾਵਲਾ ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰੂ ਤਤ ਸਾਰਖਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਭਾਖੀਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa(n) kai ghar eesar baavalaa jagat guroo tat saarakhaa giaan bhaakheele ||
lines.translation: In His House, the insane Shiva, the Guru of the World, lives; he imparts spiritual wisdom to expain the essence of reality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਡਾਂਗੀਆ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲੇਖੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: paap pu(n)n jaa(n) chai daa(n)geeaa duaarai chitr gupat lekheeaa ||
lines.translation: Sin and virtue are the standard-bearers at His Door; Chitr and Gupt are the recording angels of the conscious and subconscious.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਪਰੁਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dharam raai parulee pratihaar ||
lines.translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma, the Lord of Destruction, is the door-man.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋੁ ਐਸਾ ਰਾਜਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sou aisaa raajaa sree gopaal ||2||
lines.translation: Such is the Supreme Sovereign Lord of the World. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਰਿਖੀ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਢਾਢੀਆ ਗਾਵੰਤ ਆਛੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa(n) chai ghar gan ga(n)dharab rikhee bapuRe dhaadheeaa gaava(n)t aachhai ||
lines.translation: In His Home are the heavenly heralds, celestial singers, Rishis and poor minstrels, who sing so sweetly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁ ਰੂਪੀਆ ਅਨਗਰੂਆ ਆਖਾੜਾ ਮੰਡਲੀਕ ਬੋਲ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਕਾਛੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab saasatr bahu roopeeaa anagarooaa aakhaaRaa ma(n)daleek bol bolahi kaachhe ||
lines.translation: All the Shaastras take various forms in His theater, singing beautiful songs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਉਰ ਢੂਲ ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਹੈ ਪਵਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaur dhool jaa(n) chai hai pavan ||
lines.translation: The wind waves the fly-brush over Him;

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੇਰੀ ਸਕਤਿ ਜੀਤਿ ਲੇ ਭਵਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: cheree sakat jeet le bhavan ||
lines.translation: His hand-maiden is Maya, who has conquered the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਡ ਟੂਕ ਜਾ ਚੈ ਭਸਮਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)d took jaa chai bhasamatee ||
lines.translation: The shell of the earth is His fireplace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋੁ ਐਸਾ ਰਾਜਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਪਤੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sou aisaa raajaa tribhavan patee ||3||
lines.translation: Such is the Sovereign Lord of the three worlds. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਕੂਰਮਾ ਪਾਲੁ ਸਹਸ੍ਰ ਫਨੀ ਬਾਸਕੁ ਸੇਜ ਵਾਲੂਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa(n) chai ghar kooramaa paal sahasr phanee baasak sej vaalooaa ||
lines.translation: In His Home, the celestial turtle is the bed-frame, woven with the strings of the thousand-headed snake.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਠਾਰਹ ਭਾਰ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਮਾਲਣੀ ਛਿਨਵੈ ਕਰੋੜੀ ਮੇਘ ਮਾਲਾ ਪਾਣੀਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: athaarah bhaar banaasapatee maalanee chhinavai karoRee megh maalaa paaneehaareeaa ||
lines.translation: His flower-girls are the eighteen loads of vegetation; His water-carriers are the nine hundred sixty million clouds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਖ ਪ੍ਰਸੇਵ ਜਾ ਚੈ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: nakh prasev jaa chai surasaree ||
lines.translation: His sweat is the Ganges River.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਪਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘੜਥਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sapat samu(n)d jaa(n) chai ghaRathalee ||
lines.translation: The seven seas are His water-pitchers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਵਰਤਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ete jee jaa(n) chai varatanee ||
lines.translation: The creatures of the world are His household utensils.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋੁ ਐਸਾ ਰਾਜਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਧਣੀ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sou aisaa raajaa tribhavan dhanee ||4||
lines.translation: Such is the Sovereign Lord King of the three worlds. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਨਿਕਟ ਵਰਤੀ ਅਰਜਨੁ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਅੰਬਰੀਕੁ ਨਾਰਦੁ ਨੇਜੈ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਬਾਨਵੈ ਹੇਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa(n) chai ghar nikat varatee arajan dhroo prahalaad a(n)bareek naarad nejai sidh budh gan ga(n)dharab baanavai helaa ||
lines.translation: In His home are Arjuna, Dhroo, Prahlaad, Ambreek, Naarad, Nayjaa, the Siddhas and Buddhas, the ninety-two heavenly heralds and celestial singers in their wondrous play.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਹਹਿ ਘਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ete jee jaa(n) chai hahi gharee ||
lines.translation: All the creatures of the world are in His House.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਬਿਆਪਿਕ ਅੰਤਰ ਹਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab biaapik a(n)tar haree ||
lines.translation: The Lord is diffused in the inner beings of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਤਾਂ ਚੀ ਆਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: pranavai naamadeu taa(n) chee aan ||
lines.translation: Prays Naam Dayv, seek His Protection.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭਗਤ ਜਾ ਚੈ ਨੀਸਾਣਿ ॥੫॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sagal bhagat jaa chai neesaan ||5||1||
lines.translation: All the devotees are His banner and insignia. ||5||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: malaar ||
lines.translation: Malaar:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਤੂੰ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਤੂ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mo kau too(n) na bisaar too na bisaar ||
lines.translation: Please do not forget me; please do not forget me,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: too na bisaare raamaeeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: please do not forget me, O Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਲਾਵੰਤੀ ਇਹੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਜੋ ਹੈ ਮੁਝ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਭ ਕੋਪਿਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aalaava(n)tee ihu bhram jo hai mujh oopar sabh kopilaa ||
lines.translation: The temple priests have doubts about this, and everyone is furious with me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਦੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਉਠਾਇਓ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਬਾਪ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sood sood kar maar uthaaio kahaa karau baap beethulaa ||1||
lines.translation: Calling me low-caste and untouchable, they beat me and drove me out; what should I do now, O Beloved Father Lord? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਏ ਹੂਏ ਜਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੇਹੁਗੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mooe hooe jau mukat dehuge mukat na jaanai koilaa ||
lines.translation: If You liberate me after I am dead, no one will know that I am liberated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਪੰਡੀਆ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਢੇਢ ਕਹਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਪੈਜ ਪਿਛੰਉਡੀ ਹੋਇਲਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: e pa(n)deeaa mo kau dhedh kahat teree paij pichha(n)udee hoilaa ||2||
lines.translation: These Pandits, these religious scholars, call me low-born; when they say this, they tarnish Your honor as well. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਜੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ਅਤਿਭੁਜ ਭਇਓ ਅਪਾਰਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too j daiaal kripaal kaheeat hai(n) atibhuj bhaio apaaralaa ||
lines.translation: You are called kind and compassionate; the power of Your Arm is absolutely unrivalled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫੇਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਕਉ ਪੰਡੀਅਨ ਕਉ ਪਿਛਵਾਰਲਾ ॥੩॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pher deeaa dehuraa naame kau pa(n)deean kau pichhavaaralaa ||3||2||
lines.translation: The Lord turned the temple around to face Naam Dayv; He turned His back on the Brahmins. ||3||2||
